# DevMate Solutions

> DevMate Solutions is an AI agency based in Business Bay, Dubai, UAE, with offices in Muscat and New York. We build AI call assistants, agentic AI, WhatsApp and website AI agents, AI automation and AI lead management, in Arabic and English, for businesses in the UAE and worldwide.

Legal name: TechMate Solutions FZ LLC, trading as DevMate Solutions. Contact: contact@devmatesolutions.com. Pricing is quoted after a short demo call.

## AI services
- [AI Agency in Dubai](https://devmatesolutions.com/ai-agency-dubai): overview of our AI services, the industries we serve, and how to choose an AI partner
- [AI Call Assistant in Dubai](https://devmatesolutions.com/ai-call-assistant-dubai): voice agents that answer and make calls in Arabic and English, qualify callers and book appointments
- [Agentic AI in Dubai](https://devmatesolutions.com/agentic-ai-dubai): AI agents that complete multi-step work across business systems
- [AI Automation in Dubai](https://devmatesolutions.com/ai-automation-dubai): automated first replies, follow-ups, booking and CRM logging
- [WhatsApp AI Automation](https://devmatesolutions.com/whatsappautomation): WhatsApp AI agents for enquiries, qualification and booking
- [AI Call Agents demos](https://devmatesolutions.com/callagents): live AI voice demos for real estate and hotel booking, in English and Arabic
- [AI Lead Management](https://devmatesolutions.com/aileadmanagementdubairealestate): one AI pipeline for every lead source
